messages:
Carla M: Heads-up — planned canary policy swap for AP-SOUTH-1 edge at 2026-04-10 09:00 UTC (T+45m). Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m checks between steps. I will execute the policy changes. Expect short DNS weight updates via infra API.

Ben R: I can run the smoke checks and monitor latency/5xx. Will be oncall during the window. Ping me when you start each step. :ok_hand:

Sunny P: Confirming current DNS TTLs are 60s for the edge record? Also are we doing weighted Route53 or internal router weights? Need to know rollback primitive.

Carla M: TTL currently set to 60s. We're not changing DNS records; we'll update internal routing weights (nginx upstream via infra-api) — so no public DNS churn. For long tail failovers we still have DNS fallback but not touching it for this run.

Maya L: Rollback playbook is the usual one: set canary weight back to 0, cancel any pending autoscale, and re-route traffic to stable pool. Quick commands are in runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-canary-swap>.

Ben R: Copy. I'll use these smoke checks (run in order):
```
# basic health
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://ap-south1-edge.redwood/api/health
# smoke inference
curl -sS -X POST https://ap-south1-edge.redwood/api/predict -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' | jq '.status'
# latency sample
for i in {1..5}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{time_total}\n' https://ap-south1-edge.redwood/api/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'; done
```
I will report status after each step.

infra-bot: Canary job scheduled by Carla M. JobID: canary-20260410-apso-001. Initial weight set to 5%. Expected step intervals: 10m. Watch metrics: grafana/dashboard/edge-latency, grafana/dashboard/edge-5xx.

Sunny P: Noted. I'll keep an eye on edge-e2e and the CDN layer. If 5xxs spike > 1% in 2m or p50 latency increases >200ms, we abort and rollback.

Carla M: Agree to those abort thresholds. Also watch KV cache hit rate — if it drops >10% we pause.

Ben R: Starting checklist before swap:
- run existing smoke curl commands (done)
- confirm canary instance health (ok)
- ensure no deployments to model-serving in the window (hold tag applied)

Maya L: I've applied hold-tags on model-serving and edge-service in deploy engine. No new merges will deploy.

Carla M: Starting step 1 -> update weight to 25% (internal infra change). Ben, run smoke checks and post results in this thread. If green, I'll continue to 50% in 10m.

deploy-bot: canary-20260410-apso-001: weight-update -> 25% applied by Carla M at 2026-04-10T09:00:12Z.

Ben R: Smoke results step1: health 200, predict status OK, avg latency 210ms, 5xx 0.0%, cache hit stable. :white_check_mark:

Carla M: Proceeding to 50% in 1m. Notifying ops to monitor.

infra-bot: canary-20260410-apso-001: weight-update -> 50% applied at 2026-04-10T09:11:05Z.

Ben R: Smoke results step2 (50%): health 200, predict OK, p50 235ms, 5xx 0.2% (within threshold). Cache hit -1%. Recommend continue to 100% after 10m: :+1:

Sunny P: CDN edge metrics look fine. No increase in origin error rate.

Carla M: Proceeding to 100% now. Ben — final smoke after final step and then we can close the job.

deploy-bot: canary-20260410-apso-001: weight-update -> 100% applied at 2026-04-10T09:22:10Z. Finalizing job.

Ben R: Final smoke: health 200, predict OK, p50 260ms (expected), 5xx 0.3% (still under abort), cache hit steady. No rollback needed. :tada:

Carla M: Thanks all. I'll update the runbook with observed timings and small note to keep TTL at 60s next run. Closing the canary. If anyone sees anomalies, reopen this thread and ping @Carla M and @Ben R.

Maya L: I'll roll final metrics into post-rollout report.

infra-bot: canary-20260410-apso-001: status -> success.

Carla M: Closing thread. Great job team! :rocket:
